ARGO_APP.description: Argo CD only: the one Application every event syncs. Unset, the event's Space names the Applications to sync.

ARGO_NAMESPACE.description: Argo CD only: namespace holding the Applications.

ARGO_REFRESH_TYPE.description: Argo CD only: refresh to request. hard re-resolves the source, including an OCI tag's digest.

CONFIGHUB_AUTH_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private JWK of the ConfigHub service account argobot authenticates as, as cub serviceaccount key add --generate writes it. Required; supply it from a Secret.

CONFIGHUB_CHANNEL.description: ConfigHub Channel argobot claims and polls, as space/slug or a UUID. Its Subscriptions, set with cub, decide which events argobot receives. Required.

CONFIGHUB_REPORT_LIVE_STATUS.description: Whether argobot writes the status of what the controller deployed to each Release's LiveStatus.

CONFIGHUB_TARGET.description: ConfigHub Target that represents the cluster, as space/slug or a UUID. When set, argobot stores facts about the cluster on it at startup, which needs Edit on the Target.

CONFIGHUB_URL.description: Base URL of the ConfigHub API, as argobot reaches it. Required.

FLUX_NAMESPACE.description: Flux only: where argobot looks for the OCIRepository named after a Space when listing OCIRepositories fails.
